overview: By noon the fifth-act sheet held fourteen lines. You cut off the corner where you sneezed with the pen loaded, using your father's glover's paring-knife, so you would not keep looking at the blot. Forsworn stands three times in the last four lines. Gib was asleep on the Golding, and you did not move him.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Cut the corner and left the fourteen lines as they stood.
